Psiphon 82 handler ui is a Android vpn app that has a ui embedded in it and the size is just 5 MB, which is very easy to install.

Reasons why the user interface is embedded in the psiphon handler, is because of the need to add a working proxy server that enables android phone users to browse free with there various internet service providers sim cards or WiFi service.

It also comes with five Servers which serves as a VPN to encrypt and hide your real information, it also helps you bypass any restrictions imposed by government or any website that limits it features to a specific country.

Features Of Psiphon 82 Handler

The Handler ui is composed of the following functions which you can see after you install the app:

  • Backquery
  • MiddleQuery
  • Filter
  • Add port to non port URL
  • Remove Port
  • Proxy Type
  • Proxy Server
  • Password
  • Username
  • Custom Header
  • Real Proxy type
  • Port
  • Frontquery
– The “More Options” section has proxy settings which you can tick connect through an http to add IP address and port

– “Tick Tunnel Whole device” to power other apps when psiphon handleconnected.

– In the options tab you can select regions (server) like, United States, United kingdom, Singapore, Netherlands, Germany, and all of them are always available without any downtime.

Download Psiphon 82 Handler Ui

You can download it from the link below:
